source.statement: SELECT 4488000 AS TOTAL_PROFIT, 4410000 AS TOTAL_PRIOR, 1306000 AS FUEL_PROFIT, 1220000 AS FUEL_PRIOR, 812000 AS FUEL_LOY, 494000 AS FUEL_NONLOY, 1825000 AS MERCH_PROFIT, 1900000 AS MERCH_PRIOR, 1180000 AS MERCH_LOY, 645000 AS MERCH_NONLOY, 520000 AS LFK_PROFIT, 480000 AS LFK_PRIOR, 322000 AS LFK_LOY, 198000 AS LFK_NONLOY, 837000 AS QSR_PROFIT, 810000 AS QSR_PRIOR, 566000 AS QSR_LOY, 271000 AS QSR_NONLOY

SELECT * FROM VALUES
  ('Fuel','Loyalty',812000),('Fuel','Non-Loyalty',494000),
  ('Merch','Loyalty',1180000),('Merch','Non-Loyalty',645000),
  ('LFK','Loyalty',322000),('LFK','Non-Loyalty',198000),
  ('QSR','Loyalty',566000),('QSR','Non-Loyalty',271000)
AS t(CATEGORY, LOYALTY_SEGMENT, PROFIT)
